Global (All).title: Cyber-attacks target major US infrastructure
Global (All).summary: A series of coordinated cyber-attacks has been launched against critical US infrastructure, including power grids and financial systems, over the past week.

Global (All).title: Global economic warning as trade war tensions escalate
Global (All).summary: The ongoing trade war between the US and China has reached a boiling point, sparking concerns of a potential global economic downturn.

Global (All).title: Climate protests spread globally as pressure mounts on governments
Global (All).summary: Massive climate protests have erupted across the world, demanding action from governments to address the worsening climate crisis.

United States.title: Florida Republican Sen. Rick Scott calls for the suspension of the US Constitution if Joe Biden and Kamala Harris are re-elected
United States.summary: Sen. Scott expressed his concerns if the 'election integrity' measures are not taken, and said the Constitution should be put 'on hold'. His statement was widely criticized by his Democratic colleagues and legal analysts, who pointed out that this would be a highly unconstitutional and undemocratic act.

United States.title: Biden signs climate law extension, but Democrats fear it may not be enough to meet US targets
United States.summary: The Inflation Reduction Act, signed by the US President, aims to reduce greenhouse gas emissions and invest in clean energy. However, some Democrats worry that the measures might not be sufficient to meet the country's climate goals, which could lead to further political tensions and environmental concerns.

United States.title: Supreme Court rejects Trump-backed challenge to student loan forgiveness plan
United States.summary: The Supreme Court has ruled that the Biden administration's student loan forgiveness plan, championed by Trump, is lawful. This decision has been welcomed by many progressive groups, but some conservatives have expressed their disapproval, which could lead to further political divisions.

South Korea.title: COVID-19 cases surge in South Korea despite eased restrictions
South Korea.summary: South Korea has reported a sudden rise in COVID-19 cases, with over 20,000 new infections in the past week. The surge has forced authorities to reimpose some restrictions, including increased mask-wearing and social distancing measures.

South Korea.title: Protests erupt in Seoul over President Yoon's economic policies
South Korea.summary: Thousands of protesters took to the streets in Seoul to demonstrate against President Yoon's economic policies, which they claim favor the wealthy at the expense of the working class.

South Korea.title: North Korea tests new missiles, tensions with South Korea escalate
South Korea.summary: North Korea has conducted a series of missile tests, including a possible intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM), which has triggered a diplomatic response from South Korea and the international community.

Japan.title: Nippon Ishin no Kai's Tokyo election win sparks controversy
Japan.summary: The far-right Japan Innovation party's victory in Tokyo's regional election has generated heated debates over its potential implications on Japan's politics and society.

Japan.title: Tokyo sees record-breaking summer heatwave
Japan.summary: Japan has experienced unprecedented temperatures, with Tokyo reaching a record high, sparking health concerns and power shortages.

Japan.title: Japan's defense ministry mulls over deploying military in response to China's military activity
Japan.summary: The Japanese government's plan to deploy military in response to China's growing assertiveness in the South China Sea has raised tensions between the two nations.
